page.overview:
What is Ipyr?

Ipyr was a lush, green world and the primary home-world of House Thorvald, which governed the planet as an Earldom in the Landsraad. Ipyr was Planetary Ruler Memnon Thorvald's base of operations during the first rebellion against Emperor Paul-Muad'Dib, from 10194 to 10,198 AG.

When the Emperor found out about the Earl's upcoming strike against his former home planet of Caladan, Paul ordered Stilgar and his Jihadi Fremen to completely sterilize the planet and render it lifeless. Stilgar executed this task in 10198 AG and Ipyr was inable to grow or contain life afterward.
